description: flake-parts wraps registry entries named go, cargo and uv (wrappableTools, from nix/buck2/languages.nix). A toolchain.toml that declares the toolbox meta packages instead (turnkey's own does: go-toolchain, rust-toolchain, python-toolchain) gets the unwrapped binaries, so go get / cargo add / uv add never trigger tk sync. Found while doing turnkey-pru.1. Options: wrap the tool inside the meta package's bin/, or map each language's wrapper to every registry entry that provides its tool.
title: tw wrappers never apply to meta toolchains (go-toolchain, rust-toolchain, python-toolchain)
